-- Loader round 2/2 (addxor) — requer loadstring/load
local _xor=(bit32 and bit32.bxor) or function(a,b) local r,p=0,1 for _=1,8 do local ax,bx=a%2,b%2 if ax~=bx then r=r+p end a=(a-ax)/2 b=(b-bx)/2 p=p*2 end return r end
local function _lIIliIgv(s,k)
local t,n={}, #k
for j=1,#s do
local b=string.byte(s,j)
local kb=k[((j-1)%n)+1]
local x=_xor((b + (((j-1)+39)%256)) % 256, kb)
t[j]=string.char(x)
end
return table.concat(t)
end
